In its lobby – presided over by a large industrial-inspired fireplace – is the 7I Art Gallery, an art gallery where exhibitions curated by Celia Montoya, co-founder of the Kikekeller studio, are inaugurated quarterly with guest artists from different artistic disciplines. Aequilibrium The exhibition by Pablo Quintana (Raspao) presents a universe constructed through drawings and sculptures made entirely from recycled materials. His meticulous, almost compulsive creative process brings to life characters, symbols, and delicate floral elements that embody a deeply intellectual and reflective discourse on emotions, attachment, personal growth, doubts, fears, and the search for balance. Each artwork serves as a symbolic map of the artist’s distinct life and creative stages. With this exhibition, 7I Art Gallery transforms into a giant canvas where spray paint, material upcycling, social critique, and contemporary aesthetics converge. A journey that invites the viewer to pause, observe, and reflect on what shapes us as individuals, as well as on art’s ability to give new meaning to both everyday objects and the experiences that define our lives. “The past and present wilt—I have fill’d them, emptied them. And proceed to fill my next fold of the future…” — Walt Whitman, Song of Myself . Curated by Celia Montoya, the hotel’s art curator. When & Where From September 22nd to December 13th 7I Art Gallery, at 7 Islas Hotel Lobby Calle Valverde 14, Madrid About Pablo Quintana Despite his youth, and while balancing his artistic practice with his work as a geriatric specialist physician, Pablo Quintana pours an intense personal journey of exploration into his work. Through experimentation with a wide variety of materials, he explores his own identity and his relationship with his surroundings, turning the creative act into a tool for self-discovery. En su lobby —presidido por una gran chimenea con aires industriales— se encuentra 7I Art Gallery, una galería de arte donde de manera trimestral se inauguran exhibiciones comisariadas por Celia Montoya —cofundadora del estudio Kikekeller— con artistas invitados de distintas disciplinas artísticas. Aequilibrium La exposición de Pablo Quintana (Raspao) presenta un universo construido a través de dibujos y esculturas elaborados íntegramente con materiales reciclados. Su minucioso y casi compulsivo proceso de creación da vida a personajes, símbolos y delicados elementos florales que encierran un discurso profundamente intelectual y reflexivo sobre las emociones, el apego, el crecimiento personal, las dudas, los miedos y la búsqueda del equilibrio. Cada obra actúa como un mapa simbólico de las distintas etapas vitales y creativas del artista. Con esta exposición, 7I Art Gallery se transforma en un gran lienzo donde convergen el aerosol, la reutilización de materiales, la crítica social y la estética contemporánea. Un recorrido que invita al espectador a detenerse, observar y reflexionar sobre aquello que nos constituye como individuos y sobre la capacidad del arte para resignificar tanto los objetos como las experiencias que conforman nuestra vida. “El pasado y el presente se marchitan–Y los he llenado y los he vaciado a los dos, Y prosigo llenando lo que me espera en el futuro…” – Walt Whitman, Canto a mí mismo . Exposición organizada por Celia Montoya, curadora de arte del hotel. A través de la experimentación con una amplia diversidad de materiales, explora su propia identidad y la relación con el entorno, convirtiendo el acto creativo en una herramienta de autoconocimiento.
